answer: The lagoon counter is kept in violet and kernel shows each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that burns. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 10 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 112 aliases cost 315 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
